title: NURTOPU
description:
The demo of the Wilson game update has been released. Wilson is a game like 2D Resident Evil. It also tells the adventures of a rabbit named Nurtopu. The aim is to collect diamonds and magic tubes, take them to the desired location and win the boss battles. It is a 2D platform game. The game is simple to play. My aim while making this game was to ensure that the player has a stress-free time. When we look at it from this perspective, we can call it a "hyper casual 2D platform game".
There is also a Wilson demo update in the game. It is like a 2D version of Wilson Resident Evil. We can say that it is a local and national Resident Evil.
description_short: It is a rabbit game for collecting 2d diamonds.2d hyper casual platform game.
